premise: The Moirai have cut the Thread of Truth. Three sworn heroes travel the Aegean to restore it before the polis forgets justice, courage, and wisdom.

artifacts.name: Apollo's Far-Sight
artifacts.power: A precise shot across a puzzle room

artifacts.name: Hephaestus' Firepot
artifacts.power: Breaks brittle stone and hidden seals

artifacts.name: Lamp of Diogenes
artifacts.power: Lights caverns and exposes concealed routes

scenarios.title: The Silent Oracle
scenarios.objective: Use the Lamp of Diogenes to read shadow inscriptions, then open the spring with Apollo's Far-Sight.
scenarios.philosophical_question: Is knowledge received, or earned by asking better questions?

scenarios.title: The Thread Beneath Knossos
scenarios.objective: Mark a shared route, solve the four-virtue gate, and face the echo without becoming lost in rage.
scenarios.philosophical_question: What makes a person the same self after every turning?

scenarios.title: The Unbound Winds
scenarios.objective: Coordinate switches across sea caves and return each wind to its proper vessel.

scenarios.title: The Trial in the Agora
scenarios.setting: A moonlit agora haunted by false testimony
scenarios.objective: Compare accounts, uncover contradictions, and choose the just remedy rather than the easy verdict.
scenarios.philosophical_question: Is justice merely agreement, or does it ask more of us?
